title: AI-client reference
scope: Standalone reference for Claude Code and OpenCode. Source baselines qualify each control; installed client help and configuration determine actual behavior.

items.title: Discover commands and shortcuts
items.detail: Use ? on an empty prompt for shortcuts; /help for available commands.

items.title: Start fresh or resume a conversation
items.detail: Clear/new conversation or choose a saved conversation in the same pane. This does not create a Herdr workspace.

items.title: Inspect or choose model and effort
items.detail: Model and reasoning controls. Check whether a choice persists or is session-only; EyrAgents owns the baseline.

items.title: Enter planning or request a review
items.detail: Plan before implementation, or review the diff. Review options such as --fix and --comment have additional editing/publication effects.

items.title: Inspect or compact context
items.detail: Inspect context usage, or summarize prior conversation to free context.

items.title: Reference a file or run a shell command
items.detail: Mention a file; ! runs a shell command and adds its output to the conversation.

items.title: Discover installed skills
items.detail: List native and installed workflows. Shared EyrAgents skills include /develop, /commit, /publish and /spar.

items.title: Exit the client
items.detail: Leave Claude Code; the Herdr pane/layout is a separate layer.

items.title: Discover commands and help
items.detail: Open help or the command palette. EyrAgents does not remap the native TUI keys.

items.title: Start fresh or choose a session
items.detail: Also Ctrl+X then n/l. These operate inside the existing pane.

items.title: Choose model or reasoning variant
items.detail: Ctrl+T cycles variants. Under EyrAgents, Default retains configured xhigh; it does not mean medium.

items.title: Choose Build, Plan or a subagent
items.detail: Tab cycles primary agents. @auditor invokes the configured read-only auditor. Agent mode and permissions are distinct settings.

items.title: Compact the conversation
items.detail: Summarize prior conversation; Ctrl+X then c is the native shortcut.

items.title: Reference files or run a shell command
items.detail: File mentions and shell output become conversation context.

items.title: Select a workflow
items.detail: Select a skill, or use the commit, publish and spar wrappers in Build. Commit and publication retain their separate approval boundaries.

items.title: Develop in the current agent mode
items.detail: The managed wrapper inherits the current agent under the checked 1.18.31 command contract. A plan-only prompt tests instruction adherence; native Plan/Build slash-command acceptance remains separate.

items.title: Undo or redo a conversation step and its edits
items.detail: These also revert or restore file changes, using Git. They are not display-only transcript navigation.

items.title: Exit the client
items.detail: Aliases /quit and /q are also available.

items.title: Write a multiline prompt
items.detail: Ctrl+J inserts a newline. Ctrl+G opens an external editor for longer prompts.

items.title: Interrupt or inspect a response
items.detail: Esc interrupts; Ctrl+O opens the transcript viewer. Ctrl+T toggles the task checklist.

items.title: Write a multiline prompt
items.detail: Ctrl+J inserts a newline. Ctrl+X, release, then e opens the external editor, also /editor.

items.title: Interrupt the active response
items.detail: The checked prompt implementation requires two Esc presses to abort. Follow the on-screen interrupt hint on newer builds.

eyragents.name: EyrAgents
eyragents.open: Open docs/workspace-guide.html from this checkout in a browser.
notes: Global client configuration and shared skills apply in every project. A project needs no EyrAgents-specific import.
Terminal and multiplexer interception can affect key delivery. Use the client-specific newline/editor controls and current on-screen help.
Native conversation continuation and working-directory restoration are client-specific. Check the target directory before changing live configuration.
Saved keys are browser-local. Import an exported saved-keys file to transfer recognized AI action IDs; no browser profile is read or migrated automatically.

workflows.title: Shared workflows
workflows.text: Develop carries substantive work from its goal to a verified result with lightweight continuity. It offers Prepare commit reviews or Pause here when Git preparation has not already been directed. Commit and publish retain their separate exact approvals and reuse the same workstream. Use the installed skill picker or name the relevant skill; procedures live in the skills, not this guide.

workflows.title: Evidence and live help
workflows.text: The source register distinguishes reviewed documentation, source snapshots and installed-release evidence. A documented shortcut is not proof of effective model, effort, permissions or session state.

workflows.title: Read scope and persistent scratch
workflows.text: Shared guidance authorizes reads everywhere except secrets and personal folders, and in-scope implementation in the repository and ~/Projects/eyrie/scrape. Remote-changing and destructive commands raise a native prompt. Persistent scratch is preserved project work. The access policy maps each client's rules and remaining limits; restart affected clients after configuration changes.

checks.text: Check each tool from a shell and use its /help. Model/effort/session overrides are client state, not fixed by the launcher.
